Class InventoryController

java.lang.Object
edu.tamu.csce331.squad23.controller.InventoryController
public class InventoryController extends Object
Controller for the manager's Inventory screen (inventory-view.fxml). Lists every visible ingredient, adds new ingredients from a form, saves edits made directly in the table, and removes (hides) ingredients.

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      public void initialize()
      Called by JavaFX after the FXML is loaded. Sets up the table columns and their in-place editing (the id stays read-only, and a quantity that isn't a whole number is rejected), connects the Add and Remove buttons, and starts loading the ingredient list.

    • loadIngredients

      private void loadIngredients()
      Loads every visible ingredient in the background and shows them in the table. The status label reports progress, the number loaded, or the error.

    • addIngredient

      private void addIngredient()
      Adds a new ingredient from the form in the background. On success the ingredient is added to the top of the table and the form is cleared. On failure the form keeps its values and the error is shown in the status label. A quantity that isn't a whole number is rejected before saving.

    • removeIngredient

      private void removeIngredient()
      Removes the selected ingredient in the background. The ingredient is hidden rather than deleted, so the row is kept in the database. Does nothing if no row is selected.

    • saveEdit

      private void saveEdit(Ingredient original, Ingredient updated)
      Saves a table edit in the background. On success the row is replaced with the saved ingredient. On failure the table is refreshed so the cell shows its previous value again, and the error is shown in the status label.
      Parameters:
      original - the ingredient as currently shown in the table
      updated - the ingredient with the edited values to save
